profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer at Uber
profile.summary:
Software Engineer

- Experience working with large-scale distributed systems and what they involve: caching, event queues, sharding, offline processing.

- Experience building developer tooling from CLIs to IDE extensions and coding frameworks. Capable of moving across different layers in the developer tooling stack: IDE UIs, LSPs, Build Systems, CI, etc

- Experience working with GenAI apps for developer tooling: MCP servers implementation and deployment, Rules and Coding Assistants.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
Making the developer experience smooth across different stages in the SDLC: Building AI foundational components to enhance the developer experience.

- Worked on distributed systems that power the Rider and Driver experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led a team of Software and Data Engineers during the development of a web application used for visualizing predictive analysis for social media posts.

Technologies used: Python 3, Flask, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud.

Helped in the development of Alexa skills aimed to convert text to audio using AWS technologies. 

Technologies used: Node JS, Serverless Framework, AWS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Assigned to SkyTouch Technologies:

Member of a high-velocity team created to build custom features required for one of the largest tenants of the applications.

Stack: Java, several Spring projects, SQL Server, Jenkins, Git

Duties at Nearsoft:
Build applications aimed to help in internal processes and recruiting campaigns.
Part of several internal teams responsible for Internship and Training programs.
Mentored new talent coming from Internship programs.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
Built a brand new web application for one of the most recognized chefs in Mexico. 

Created REST APIs to offer feature parity between the web and mobile experience.
